title: Profiting from Predictability: Smart Traders, Daily Price Limits, and Investor Attention
one_line: In Shanghai, stocks hitting their upper daily price limit attract attention-driven retail buying the next day, then reverse within days; 'smart' traders buy on limit days and sell to the retail wave.

findings.statement: Next-day retail buying and price rise, then reversal within ~5 days.
